technical.summary: IRM shows solid bullish structure with price above all key MAs and three white soldiers pattern, but weak trend strength (ADX 23), negative MACD histogram, and overbought Williams %R limit conviction for a high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: IRM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 55 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear sentiment (24/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news data limit conviction; neutral overall signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (295.5) indicates extreme market stress, rising DXY pressures multinationals, and credit spreads likely widening; IRM faces compounded cyclical and liquidity risks despite 55-day earnings buffer.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with three white soldiers pattern and supertrend confirmation offers technical structure, while extreme fear sentiment (24/100) presents classic contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 295.5, rising DXY, credit stress), weak trend strength (ADX 23), negative MACD histogram, overbought Williams %R, zero fundamental conviction, and high earnings risk in 55 days create compounded cyclical and technical deterioration risk.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure shows price above MAs with three white soldiers, but macro environment is severely deteriorated with inverted yield curve and VIX crisis levels creating compounded cyclical risk that outweighs contrarian sentiment opportunity.
decision.primary_risk: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX 295.5 crisis, rising DXY, credit stress) combined with weak trend strength (ADX 23) and negative MACD histogram create high probability of pullback into earnings in 55 days.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding 14 Real Estate positions and existing IRM position; sector concentration and ticker overlap reduce conviction further; portfolio drawdown at 0% allows flexibility but macro environment argues for capital preservation.
